status.en: 4 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 67% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Fallujah.
status.nb: 4 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 67 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Fallujah.

summary.en: Iranian drones struck a Komala base in Erbil with no casualties while Iran intensified attacks on Kurdish opposition groups in northern Iraq and a militia leader publicly criticized Iraq's stance on the Iran blockade. Iraqi security forces captured a notorious ISIS gang member in Kirkuk, arrested suspects for usury in Wasit, embezzlement in Mosul and defamation in Najaf, and foiled petroleum-product smuggling in territorial waters. Washington is expanding Shia outreach in Iraq, and NATO held a high-level political dialogue with Iraqi officials. A Jewish heritage museum opened in Baghdad and Iran exempted ships from India and three other nations from Strait of Hormuz transit restrictions. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Iranske droner slo til mot en Komala-base i Erbil uten dødsfall, mens Iran intensiverte angrep på kurdiske opposisjonsgrupper i Nord-Irak og en militsleder offentlig kritiserte Iraks holdning til Irans blokade. Iraks sikkerhetsstyrker fanget et beryktet ISIS-gjengmedlem i Kirkuk, arresterte mistenkte for rentesrente i Wasit, underslag i Mosul og ærekrenkelser i Najaf, og avverget smugling av petroleumsprodukter i territorialfarvann. Washington utvider sjia-utdypning i Irak, og NATO holdt en høypolitisk dialog med irakiske tjenestemenn. Et jødisk kulturhistorisk museum åpnet i Bagdad, og Iran unntok skip fra India og tre andre nasjoner fra transittrestriksjoner i Hormuzstredet. UCDP registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
